Errors shouldn't be reported inside `raw` elements, or at least the ones about Jinja formatting (202, 206 and 209) should be ignored. ### 1.1-1.3 Problem Analysis

The issue describes a bug where **salt-lint incorrectly reports Jinja formatting errors (202, 206, and 209) inside Jinja raw blocks**. 

Key technical details:
- **Error codes**: 202, 206, 209 (Jinja formatting violations)
- **Raw block delimiters**: `{% raw %}` and `{% endraw %}`
- **File type**: `.sls` files (SaltStack state files)
- **Example error**: `[206] Jinja variables should have spaces before and after: {{ var_name }}`

The problem is that salt-lint doesn't respect Jinja's raw block semantics - content inside `{% raw %}` blocks should not be processed as Jinja template code, so Jinja-related linting rules should be skipped.

### 1.4 Steps to Reproduce
1. Create a `.sls` file with content inside `{% raw %}` blocks containing Jinja-like syntax (e.g., `{{.spec.clusterIP}}`)
2. Run `salt-lint` on the file
3. Observe that Jinja formatting errors are incorrectly reported

### 1.5 Best Practices for Testing and Fixing
- Parse content to identify raw block boundaries
- Skip Jinja-related linting rules for content within raw blocks
- Ensure fix doesn't break existing functionality outside raw blocks
- Test edge cases like nested raw blocks, malformed blocks, etc.

## Phase 2. RUNNING: Setting Up and Running Tests

    83	
    84	On a system with SELinux, change `:ro` to `:Z`. Example below uses podman:
    85	
    86	```bash
    87	podman run -v $(pwd):/data:Z --entrypoint=/bin/bash -it warpnetbv/salt-lint:latest -c 'find /data -type f -name "*.sls" -print0 | xargs -0 --no-run-if-empty salt-lint'
    88	```
    89	
    90	### GitHub Action
    91	
    92	Salt-lint is available on the GitHub [marketplace](https://github.com/marketplace/actions/salt-lint) as a GitHub Action. The `salt-lint-action` allows you to run ``salt-lint`` with no additional options.
    93	
    94	To use the action simply add the following lines to your `.github/workflows/main.yml`.
    95	
    96	```yaml
    97	on: [push]
    98	
    99	jobs:
   100	  test:
   101	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
   102	    name: Salt Lint Action
   103	    steps:
   104	    - uses: actions/checkout@v1
   105	    - name: Run salt-lint
   106	      uses: roaldnefs/salt-lint-action@master
   107	      env:
   108	        ACTION_STATE_NAME: init.sls
   109	```

   111	## Configuring
   112	
   113	### Configuration File
   114	
   115	Salt-lint supports local configuration via a `.salt-lint` configuration file. Salt-lint checks the working directory for the presence of this file and applies any configuration found there. The configuration file location can also be overridden via the `-c path/to/file` CLI flag.
   116	
   117	If a value is provided on both the command line and via a configuration file, the values will be merged (if a list like **exclude_paths**), or the **True** value will be preferred, in the case of something like **quiet**.
   118	
   119	The following values are supported, and function identically to their CLI counterparts:
   120	
   121	```yaml
   122	---
   123	exclude_paths:
   124	  - exclude_this_file
   125	  - exclude_this_directory/
   126	  - exclude/this/sub-directory/
   127	skip_list:
   128	  - 207
   129	  - 208
   130	tags:
   131	  - formatting
   132	verbosity: 1
   133	rules:
   134	  formatting:
   135	    ignore: |
   136	      ignore/this/directory/*.sls
   137	      *.jinja
   138	  210:
   139	    ignore: 'exclude_this_file.sls'
   140	severity: True
   141	```
   142	
   143	### Pre-commit Setup
   144	
   145	To use salt-lint with [pre-commit](https://pre-commit.com),  just add the following to your local repo's `.pre-commit-config.yaml` file. Prior to version 0.12.0 of [pre-commit](https://pre-commit.com) the file was `hooks.yaml` (now `.pre-commit-config.yaml`).
   146	
   147	```yaml
   148	---
   149	
   150	# For use with pre-commit.
   151	# See usage instructions at http://pre-commit.com
   152	
   153	-   repo: https://github.com/warpnet/salt-lint
   154	    rev: v0.5.1
   155	    hooks:
   156	      - id: salt-lint
   157	```
   158	
   159	Optionally override the default file selection as follows:
   160	
   161	```yaml
   162	      ...
   163	      - id: salt-lint
   164	        files: \.(sls|jinja|tmpl)$
   165	```

   167	## Rules
   168	
   169	### List of rules
   170	
   171	#### Formatting
   172	
   173	Disable formatting checks using `-x formatting`
   174	
   175	Rule | Description
   176	:-:|:--
   177	[201](https://github.com/warpnet/salt-lint/wiki/201) | Trailing whitespace
   178	[202](https://github.com/warpnet/salt-lint/wiki/202) | Jinja statement should have spaces before and after: `{% statement %}`
   179	[203](https://github.com/warpnet/salt-lint/wiki/203) | Most files should not contain tabs
   180	[204](https://github.com/warpnet/salt-lint/wiki/204) | Lines should be no longer than 160 chars
   181	[205](https://github.com/warpnet/salt-lint/wiki/205) | Use ".sls" as a Salt State file extension
   182	[206](https://github.com/warpnet/salt-lint/wiki/206) | Jinja variables should have spaces before and after `{{ var_name }}`
   183	[207](https://github.com/warpnet/salt-lint/wiki/207) | File modes should always be encapsulated in quotation marks
   184	[208](https://github.com/warpnet/salt-lint/wiki/208) | File modes should always contain a leading zero
   185	[209](https://github.com/warpnet/salt-lint/wiki/209) | Jinja comment should have spaces before and after: `{# comment #}`
   186	[210](https://github.com/warpnet/salt-lint/wiki/210) | Numbers that start with `0` should always be encapsulated in quotation marks
   187	[211](https://github.com/warpnet/salt-lint/wiki/211) | `pillar.get` or `grains.get` should be formatted differently
   188	[212](https://github.com/warpnet/salt-lint/wiki/212) | Most files should not contain irregular spaces
   189	[213](https://github.com/warpnet/salt-lint/wiki/213) | SaltStack recommends using `cmd.run` together with `onchanges`, rather than `cmd.wait`
   190	[214](https://github.com/warpnet/salt-lint/wiki/214) | SLS file with a period in the name (besides the suffix period) can not be referenced
   191	
   192	#### Jinja
   193	
   194	Disable jinja checks using `-x jinja`
   195	
   196	Rule | Description
   197	:-:|:--
   198	[202](https://github.com/warpnet/salt-lint/wiki/202) | Jinja statement should have spaces before and after: `{% statement %}`
   199	[206](https://github.com/warpnet/salt-lint/wiki/206) | Jinja variables should have spaces before and after `{{ var_name }}`
   200	[209](https://github.com/warpnet/salt-lint/wiki/209) | Jinja comment should have spaces before and after: `{# comment #}`
   201	[211](https://github.com/warpnet/salt-lint/wiki/211) | `pillar.get` or `grains.get` should be formatted differently
   202	
   203	#### Deprecations
   204	
   205	Disable deprecation checks using `-x deprecation`
   206	
   207	Rule | Description
   208	:-:|:--
   209	[901](https://github.com/warpnet/salt-lint/wiki/901) | Using the `quiet` argument with `cmd.run` is deprecated. Use `output_loglevel: quiet`
   210	
   211	### False Positives: Skipping Rules
   212	
   213	Some rules are bit of a rule of thumb. To skip a specific rule for a specific task, inside your state add `# noqa [rule_id]` at the end of the line. You can skip multiple rules via a space-separated list. Example:
   214	
   215	```yaml
   216	/tmp/testfile:
   217	  file.managed:
   218	    - source: salt://{{unspaced_var}}/example  # noqa: 206
   219	```

   233	## Fix common issues
   234	
   235	`sed` might be one of the better tools to fix common issues, as shown in commands below.
   236	
   237	**Note**: these commands assume your current working directory is the salt (states) directory/repository.
   238	
   239	Fix spacing around `{{ var_name }}`, eg. `{{env}}` --> `{{ env }}`:\
   240	`sed -i -E "s/\{\{\s?([^}]*[^} ])\s?\}\}/\{\{ \1 \}\}/g"  $(find . -name '*.sls')`
   241	
   242	Make the `dir_mode`, `file_mode` and `mode` arguments in the desired syntax:\
   243	`sed -i -E "s/\b(dir_|file_|)mode: 0?([0-7]{3})/\1mode: '0\2'/"  $(find . -name '*.sls')`
   244	
   245	Add quotes around numeric values that start with a `0`:\
   246	`sed -i -E "s/\b(minute|hour): (0[0-7]?)\$/\1: '\2'/"  $(find . -name '*.sls')`
